title: 01Sequence
constraintsSummary: Time limit: 2 sec; Memory limit: 1024 MiB; Constraints: 1 \leq N \leq 2 \times 10^5; 1 \leq M \leq \min(2 \times 10^5, \frac{N(N+1)}{2} ); 1 \leq L_i \leq R_i \leq N; 1 \leq X_i \leq R_i-L_i+1; (L_i,R_i) \neq (L_j,R_j) if i \neq j.; All values in input are integers.
